---
title: "Simulation (paper), step 4.1: fit the Bayesian models (pathologists)"
---

Step 4.1 of the paper simulation (pathologist design): fit the compiled binomial + Poisson model of
step 3.1 to every dataset of step 2.1 (3 scenarios × 40 slides × 2 variants × 100 replicates = 600
datasets) and save the fits. Post-processing (estimands, intervals) follows in a later step.

The fits are not part of the repository (about 1.7 GB, see `fits_pathologists/README.md`), but
their diagnostics are.

**Sampler settings** (as in step 4)

- 4 chains, run one after another (`cores = 1`); the parallelisation is over the fits.
- iter 4000, warmup 1000, thin 3: 4 × 1000 = 4000 saved draws per fit.
- adapt_delta 0.95.
- Diagnostics per fit: divergences, hits of the maximum tree depth, max Rhat, min bulk and tail ESS
  (over all parameters except `lp__` and `lprior`), and Rhat, bulk and tail ESS of `lp__`.
- Diagnostics per population-level parameter (intercepts, slide and rater SDs, correlations;
  without the per-slide and per-rater effects): Rhat, bulk and tail ESS.

**Seeds** (offset from `01_seed_offsets.csv`)

- Stan: `seed + 4000000` with the dataset seed `seed` from the counts file (`seed_base + rep`).
  All variants and models of a dataset share the seed (the data or the model differ); the ML fits
  of step 4 use the same seeds on different data.

**Run**

- Parallel with `purrr::walk()` and `in_parallel()` on mirai daemons (11 workers), one job at a
  time. The templates are sent to every daemon once (`mirai::everywhere()`) and refitted with
  `update(recompile = FALSE)`.
- Jobs replicate by replicate (all scenarios, variants and models of rep 1 first).
- One file per fit. Jobs whose fit file exists are skipped, so the run can be restarted after a
  crash or run in parts (`reps_to_fit`).

**Output** (`simulation/fits_pathologists/`)

- `<model_id>/<scenario>_<n_slide>_v<variant>_r<rep>.rds`: the fit (brmsfit, xz).
- `diagnostics/<model_id>/<scenario>_<n_slide>_v<variant>_r<rep>.csv`: diagnostics of the fit
  (or the error message if the fit failed).
- `diagnostics_parameters/<model_id>/<scenario>_<n_slide>_v<variant>_r<rep>.csv`: diagnostics per
  population-level parameter.
- `04_1_fit_settings.csv`: sampler settings.
- `04_1_fit_diagnostics.csv`, `04_1_fit_diagnostics_parameters.csv`: all diagnostics combined.

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(readr)
```

# Functions
```{r}
# Columns for the binomial + Poisson model (as in step 3.1)
prepare_brms_data <- function(df_sim) {
  df_sim |>
    mutate(GroundTruth = TP + FN)    # Sensitivity/recall trials: all true objects (P)
}
```

# Settings
```{r}
n_workers <- 11
dir_fits  <- "simulation/fits_pathologists"

fit_settings <- tibble(chains = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 1000, thin = 3, adapt_delta = 0.95)

# Short model ids for the file names
df_models <- tribble(
  ~model,               ~model_id,
  "Binomial + Poisson", "binomial_poisson"
)
```

# Load data
```{r}
df_seed_offsets <- read_csv("simulation/data/01_seed_offsets.csv")
df_counts       <- read_csv("simulation/data/02_1_pathologist_observed_data.csv.xz")

offset_stan <- df_seed_offsets |> filter(step == "stan") |> pull(offset)
```

# Jobs
```{r}
# Replicates to fit (a subset for a test or a partial run)
reps_to_fit <- seq_len(max(df_counts$rep))

df_jobs <- df_counts |>
  filter(rep %in% reps_to_fit) |>
  nest(data = c(slide, rater_ID, P, TP, FN, FP)) |>
  mutate(seed_stan = seed + offset_stan) |>
  cross_join(df_models) |>
  mutate(
    file_name        = sprintf("%s_%d_v%d_r%03d", scenario, n_slide, variant, rep),
    file_fit         = file.path(dir_fits, model_id, paste0(file_name, ".rds")),
    file_diagnostics = file.path(dir_fits, "diagnostics", model_id, paste0(file_name, ".csv")),
    file_diagnostics_parameters = file.path(dir_fits, "diagnostics_parameters", model_id,
                                            paste0(file_name, ".csv"))
  ) |>
  # replicate by replicate
  arrange(rep, scenario, n_slide, variant, model_id) |>
  # skip fits that already exist
  filter(!file.exists(file_fit))

nrow(df_jobs)
```

# Fit
```{r}
walk(c(file.path(dir_fits, df_models$model_id),
       file.path(dir_fits, "diagnostics", df_models$model_id),
       file.path(dir_fits, "diagnostics_parameters", df_models$model_id)),
     \(dir) dir.create(dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE))
write_csv(fit_settings, file.path(dir_fits, "04_1_fit_settings.csv"))

# Objects for the daemons are passed as arguments (assignments inside the expression are not kept)
mirai::daemons(n_workers)
invisible(mirai::everywhere(
  {
    setwd(dir_project)
    library(dplyr)
    library(readr)
    library(brms)
  },
  dir_project = getwd(), prepare_brms_data = prepare_brms_data, fit_settings = fit_settings,
  brms_templates = readRDS("simulation/models/03_1_brms_templates_pathologists.rds")
))

t_start <- Sys.time()
df_jobs |>
  split(seq_len(nrow(df_jobs))) |>
  walk(in_parallel(\(job) {
  df_diagnostics <- tryCatch({
    t_fit <- system.time(
      fit <- update(brms_templates[[job$model]], newdata = prepare_brms_data(job$data[[1]]),
                    recompile = FALSE, chains = fit_settings$chains, cores = 1,
                    iter = fit_settings$iter, warmup = fit_settings$warmup, thin = fit_settings$thin,
                    control = list(adapt_delta = fit_settings$adapt_delta),
                    refresh = 0, seed = job$seed_stan)
    )[["elapsed"]]
    # cmdstanr leaves its csv and json files in the temp folder of the worker
    unlink(list.files(tempdir(), pattern = "\\.(csv|json)$", full.names = TRUE))

    df_nuts <- nuts_params(fit)
    df_summary_all <- posterior::summarise_draws(posterior::as_draws_array(fit), "rhat", "ess_bulk", "ess_tail")

    # Diagnostics of the population-level parameters (intercepts, slide and rater SDs,
    # correlations), without the per-slide and per-rater effects
    job |>
      select(scenario, n_slide, rep, variant, model, model_id) |>
      cross_join(df_summary_all |> filter(grepl("^(b|sd|cor)_", variable))) |>
      write_csv(job$file_diagnostics_parameters)

    # Quick summary of diagnostics
    df_summary     <- df_summary_all |> filter(!variable %in% c("lp__", "lprior"))
    df_summary_lp  <- df_summary_all |> filter(variable == "lp__")

    # Save the fit under a temporary name first, so an interrupted save leaves no fit file
    t_save <- system.time({
      saveRDS(fit, paste0(job$file_fit, ".tmp"), compress = "xz")
      file.rename(paste0(job$file_fit, ".tmp"), job$file_fit)
    })[["elapsed"]]

    tibble(
      fit_s              = t_fit,
      save_s             = t_save,
      divergences        = sum(df_nuts$Value[df_nuts$Parameter == "divergent__"]),
      max_treedepth_hits = sum(df_nuts$Value[df_nuts$Parameter == "treedepth__"] >= 10),
      max_rhat           = max(df_summary$rhat, na.rm = TRUE),
      min_ess_bulk       = min(df_summary$ess_bulk, na.rm = TRUE),
      min_ess_tail       = min(df_summary$ess_tail, na.rm = TRUE),
      rhat_lp            = df_summary_lp$rhat,
      ess_bulk_lp        = df_summary_lp$ess_bulk,
      ess_tail_lp        = df_summary_lp$ess_tail,
      error              = NA_character_
    )
  }, error = \(e) tibble(error = conditionMessage(e)))

  job |>
    select(scenario, n_slide, rep, variant, model, model_id, seed_stan) |>
    bind_cols(df_diagnostics) |>
    write_csv(job$file_diagnostics)
  NULL
}), .progress = TRUE)
mirai::daemons(0)

difftime(Sys.time(), t_start, units = "hours")
```

# Diagnostics
```{r}
df_fit_diagnostics <- list.files(file.path(dir_fits, "diagnostics"), pattern = "\\.csv$",
                                 recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE) |>
  read_csv(col_types = cols(error = col_character()))
write_csv(df_fit_diagnostics, file.path(dir_fits, "04_1_fit_diagnostics.csv"))

df_fit_diagnostics_parameters <- list.files(file.path(dir_fits, "diagnostics_parameters"), pattern = "\\.csv$",
                                            recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE) |>
  read_csv()
write_csv(df_fit_diagnostics_parameters, file.path(dir_fits, "04_1_fit_diagnostics_parameters.csv"))

# Failed fits
df_fit_diagnostics |> filter(!is.na(error))

# Summary per model, scenario and variant
df_fit_diagnostics |>
  filter(is.na(error)) |>
  group_by(model, scenario, variant) |>
  summarise(fits = n(), fits_with_div = sum(divergences > 0), treedepth_hits = sum(max_treedepth_hits),
            rhat_gt_1.01 = sum(max_rhat > 1.01), max_rhat = max(max_rhat),
            min_ess_bulk = min(min_ess_bulk), min_ess_tail = min(min_ess_tail),
            max_rhat_lp = max(rhat_lp), min_ess_bulk_lp = min(ess_bulk_lp),
            mean_fit_s = mean(fit_s), .groups = "drop")

# Summary per model and population-level parameter
df_fit_diagnostics_parameters |>
  group_by(model, variant, variable) |>
  summarise(fits = n(), rhat_gt_1.01 = sum(rhat > 1.01), max_rhat = max(rhat),
            min_ess_bulk = min(ess_bulk), min_ess_tail = min(ess_tail), .groups = "drop")
```
